items.title: Amgen (AMGN) Takes Aim At Rare Disease Delays While Expanding RNA Drug Hunt
items.summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) announced a new collaboration with the National Organization for Rare Disorders to speed rare autoimmune disease diagnosis. The partners are targeting a goal to cut average diagnosis times for selected rare autoimmune conditions by 2036 through data and education efforts.
